defaults.description: Global Redfish connection defaults applied to all hosts unless overridden

baseurl.description: Base URL of the default Redfish service (e.g., https://bmc.example.com)

password.description: Default password for Redfish authentication (prefer secure storage in production)

identity_file.description: Path to SSH private key file for fallback SSH-based authentication (optional)

login_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for login/authentication operations

retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed operations

ssl_verify.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates (set to `false` to allow self-signed certs)

use_token.description: Use token-based auth (e.g., via SSH proxy or Bearer tokens) instead of password

hosts.description: List of per-host Redfish configurations (overrides global defaults)

baseurl.description: Redfish base URL for this host (overrides global default)

password.description: Redfish password for this host (if different from global default)

identity_file.description: SSH identity file path for this host (if SSH fallback is used)

login_timeout.description: Login timeout in seconds for this host (omit to inherit from global defaults)

retries.description: Max retries for this host (omit to inherit from global defaults)

retry_wait.description: Wait time between retries for this host (omit to inherit)

ssl_verify.description: Whether to verify SSL certs for this host (omit to inherit)

use_token.description: Use token auth for this host (omit to inherit)
